But it stands as a subordinate causal clause under the first-person wish frame that opens that same verse, מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֣נִי (byte tier), the frame that also opens oshb:Jer.8.23 = web:Jer.9.1 with מִֽי יִתֵּ֤ן (byte tier); the contiguous interrogative-plus-yiqtol wish family stands in exactly 2 verses book-wide, those two adjacent sites and no other (sweep: 2 verses, MT keys oshb:Jer.8.23 and oshb:Jer.9.1). The verse after the seam is a different thing again: oshb:Jer.9.2 = web:Jer.9.3 opens verse-initially with וַֽיַּדְרְכ֤וּ (byte tier), a third-person main clause carrying no wish frame at all, and closes וְאֹתִ֥י לֹֽא יָדָ֖עוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה (byte tier), where the first person has become Yahweh's own and is sealed by the postpositive divine formula. So the discriminator has to be cut at the speaker-frame level, not at the presence of third-person description: what changes at the cut is who speaks, a tier-1 participant and speaker change, and it falls exactly there. Two byte facts leave that the only warrant available: across oshb:Jer.8.18-oshb:Jer.9.1 there is no speech formula and no postpositive divine formula (sweep: 152 verses carry the koh-amar-YHWH skeleton book-wide, 0 of them in this span, the nearest after it four verses past the seam at oshb:Jer.9.6 = web:Jer.9.7; sweep: 162 verses carry the neum-YHWH skeleton book-wide, 0 of them in this span, the formula standing at oshb:Jer.8.17 immediately before it and at oshb:Jer.9.2 immediately after it). What survives of the challenge is therefore this: the stated warrant names a feature the unit's own closing clause contains, and that straddling accusation goes undisclosed as cross-seam continuity. What does not survive is the word contradicted — the seam is tier-1 grounded on the speaker change and is not disturbed. LEG 2 (refuted on bytes). The two marks are not a symmetric pair and cannot be read as two sides of one disclosure. The setumah at oshb:Jer.8.17 closes the verse immediately preceding the unit, so it is seam-coincident with the front cut. The unit's closing verse, oshb:Jer.9.1 = web:Jer.9.2, carries 0 parashah marks, so there is no back-seam mark to disclose; the setumah at oshb:Jer.9.2 = web:Jer.9.3 closes the verse after the unit and is span-relevant to the unit beginning at web:Jer.9.3, which does disclose it. LEG 3 (real, low, not the breach implied). The two bare coordinates exist and both resolve on the WEB side inside the zone. But the unit carries 3 dual-cited zone pairs, web:Jer.9.3 = oshb:Jer.9.2, oshb:Jer.8.23 = web:Jer.9.1 and oshb:Jer.9.1 = web:Jer.9.2, each arithmetically right on the injective crosswalk, and it clears the zone-disclosure enforcement under a live-arm control check (a control copy with those duals stripped fails on 3 refs; a control copy with 1 dual mis-set fails on its arithmetic), structured references being the object the Tier-0 zone rule governs. The bare prose digits are an ambiguity residue below that threshold, cheap to cure and inconsistent with the dual practice used two sentences earlier, not a Tier-0 failure.
